title: From Ambiguous Tickets to Ranked Hypotheses: Multi-Agent Root-Cause Analysis for Autonomous Heavy-Vehicle Software
abstract: arXiv:2611.23294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous haulage systems run safety-critical software on driverless mining trucks, with no onboard driver to detect or mitigate abnormal behavior. Every failure in testing or operation must therefore be traced to its root cause to keep the safety case valid and limit downtime. An investigation often starts from a sparse ticket containing an approximate timestamp, sometimes a suspected cause, and a multimodal vehicle recording of several gigabytes. We present a multi-agent root-cause analysis (RCA) workflow that turns this input into a telemetry-grounded event chain, ranked causal hypotheses, and candidate code locations. A suspected cause in the ticket, which could anchor the analysis on a false theory, goes to a single LLM analyst in a separate agent session. Non-neural tools select the relevant telemetry once, before analysis, and an LLM condenses it into shared evidence artifacts; this more than halved the cost per incident compared

translated_title: 从模糊工单到排序假设：面向自主重型车辆软件的多智能体根因分析
translated_abstract: 自主运输系统在无人驾驶矿用卡车上运行安全关键软件，车上没有驾驶员来检测或缓解异常行为。因此，测试或运行中的每一次故障都必须追溯到其根本原因，以保持安全论证的有效性并减少停机时间。调查通常始于一份信息稀少的工单，其中包含一个大致的时间戳，有时还包含一个疑似原因，以及数吉字节的多模态车辆记录。我们提出了一种多智能体根因分析（RCA）工作流，将这些输入转化为基于遥测数据的事件链、按优先级排序的因果假设以及候选代码位置。工单中的疑似原因可能会使分析锚定在错误的理论上，因此它被发送给单独智能体会话中的单个LLM分析师。非神经工具在分析之前一次性筛选出相关遥测数据，随后由LLM将其压缩为共享证据工件；这使得每次事故的成本相比之前降低了一半以上
tldr: 该论文提出了一种多智能体根因分析工作流，将稀疏的故障工单和海量多模态车辆记录转化为基于遥测的事件链、按优先级排序的因果假设及候选代码位置，并通过隔离疑似原因、预筛选遥测数据和压缩共享证据，显著降低了每次事故的分析成本。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multi-agent root-cause analysis workflow that transforms sparse failure tickets and multi-gigabyte multimodal vehicle recordings into telemetry-grounded event chains, ranked causal hypotheses, and candidate code locations, isolating suspected causes to avoid anchoring bias and cutting per-incident analysis cost by more than half.
